tha-ap374:1.1: Pāṭalipupphiya.] *Vipassī nāma bhagavā* sayambhū aggapuggalo / purakkhato sasissehi Bandhumaṃ pavisī jino. // //
tha-ap374:2.1: Tīṇi pāṭalipupphāni ucchaṅge ṭhapitāni me / sīsaṃ nahāyitukāmo 'haṃ nadītittham agacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap374:3.1: Nikkhamma Bandhumatiyā addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ / indīvaraṃ va jalitam ādittaṃ va hutāsanaṃ // //
tha-ap374:4.1: Vyagghusabhaṃ va pavaram abhijātaṃ va kesariṃ / gacchantaṃ samaṇānaggaṃ bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṃ. // //
tha-ap374:5.1: Tasmiṃ pasanno sugate kilesamaladhovane / gahetvā tīṇipupphāni buddhaseṭṭham apūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap374:6.1: Ekanavut' ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap374:8.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pāṭalipupphiyo th. i. g. a-ti.
